app.name: Kasuwa
app.tagline: CRM and contact centre wey dem build for Africa
tokens.page.title: Design tokens
tokens.page.subtitle: Kasuwa Design {version} — na im be di only place wey colour, type, spacing and motion dey come from.
tokens.provisional.notice: Dis one never final. Dem take di three brand anchors for Prompt 0 make dis scales, and di Claude Design export go replace dem. Check decision D-L10.
tokens.contrast.label: {ratio} to 1 on top {background}
notFound.title: We no see di page
notFound.body: Di page wey you ask for no dey, or you no get permission to see am.
notFound.back: Go back to di sign-in page
tokens.approved.notice: Dem bring am from di Claude Design export wey dem approve. Machine na im pull di colour values; if you edit dem by hand, di next import go undo am.
auth.panel.headline: Every koroso wit customer. One place.
auth.panel.body: WhatsApp, call, SMS an email for sales an support team dem for Lagos, Accra, Nairobi, Joburg an Dakar.
auth.panel.trust.encryption: Bank-level lock for your data, for road an for where e dey rest
auth.panel.trust.compliance: Dem build am for NDPA (Naija) an POPIA (South Africa)
auth.panel.trust.residency: Dem dey keep your data for Africa
auth.signIn.title: Welcome back, how far?
auth.signIn.subtitle: Enter your Kasuwa work place.
auth.signIn.workspace.label: Work place
auth.signIn.workspace.help: Di short name of your work place, like sahel-bpo.
auth.signIn.email.label: Work email
auth.signIn.password.label: Password
auth.signIn.remember: Make I still dey inside for dis device
auth.locked.title: We don lock your account for 15 minutes
auth.locked.body: Plenty wrong password enter for {emailHint}. We dey lock di account so your customer dem data go safe.
auth.locked.notYou: No be you? Your admin fit see where di try dem come from.
auth.sso.title: Enter wit SSO
auth.sso.subtitle: Type your company email domain. We go carry you go your company sign-in page.
auth.sso.domain.label: Work domain
auth.sso.providers: E dey work wit Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta an any SAML 2.0 provider.
auth.slow.loading: We dey load di sign-in page
auth.slow.title: We still dey connect…
auth.slow.body: Your network slow. Small-data mode go load light page wey no get picture.
auth.lite.on: Small-data mode don on. You fit off am any time for di top bar.
auth.lite.deferred: Google, Microsoft, SSO an passkey go load wen you press dem.
auth.mfa.title.sms: Put di code wey we send
auth.mfa.body.app: Put di 6-number code from Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator abi app wey be like dem.
auth.mfa.body.sms: We send di code go {hint} for SMS. E go work for 10 minutes.
auth.mfa.code.label: 6-number code
auth.mfa.resend.in: You fit send am again for {clock}
auth.mfa.sms.slow: SMS fit take reach 2 minutes wen network full. E never enter?
auth.mfa.sms.voice: Make dem call you di code
auth.attemptsRemaining: {count, plural, one {# try remain before we lock di account for 15 minutes.} other {# tries remain before we lock di account for 15 minutes.}}
auth.error.validation_failed: Some tin wey you type never correct. Check di boxes wey we mark for down.
auth.error.invalid_credentials: Dis email an password no match. Check say you no make mistake, an check caps lock.
auth.error.account_locked: You don try to enter too many times.
auth.error.mfa_code_invalid: Dat code no match. Check your authenticator app, den try again.
auth.error.mfa_challenge_expired: Dis code don expire. Code dey work for 10 minutes. Collect new one for down — di old one no go work again.
auth.error.mfa_challenge_invalid: Enter again make you fit continue.
auth.error.resend_too_soon: Wait small before you ask for anoda code.
auth.error.sso_domain_not_found: We no see SSO for {domain}. Check how you spell am, abi ask your IT people whether dem don set SSO for Kasuwa.
auth.error.otp_invalid: Dat code no match. Check am, den try again.
auth.error.otp_expired: Dat code don expire. Code dey last ten minutes.
auth.error.otp_too_many_attempts: You don try too many times. Ask for new code.
auth.error.not_authenticated: Enter again make you fit continue.
auth.error.not_implemented: Dis part of Kasuwa never ready.
auth.error.network: We no fit reach Kasuwa. Check your network den try again.
